title: Tether as a download that updates itself

history.what: reviewed (10 findings): Reviewer found 3 blockers, 4 gaps, 3 minor. Fixed: S-3 numbers release builds from the tag so Sparkle orders rc1 < rc2 < v6.1.0, and --feed picks the test or real feed (S-9 per tag, V-4 checks the real feed live); new S-13/S-14 cut and approve rc1 and rc2; S-10 gains --withdraw with new risk R-6; S-6 keeps existing installs, compares against install-agent.sh itself and names its failure paths; T-3 probes Gatekeeper on macOS 26 before PR-2; S-8 proves the key export restores (R-3); R-4 says what a leak can do; V-1 covers REQ-1 to REQ-3. Not changed: Package.resolved is tracked; plangraph has no decider field (decisions are Jordan's). 28.75 h of 30.

body: Jordan, 15 Oct 2026, choosing the updater: "Yes" to "Use Sparkle for the updater". Then: "Back to the plan for Tether".
